relations.statement: If a map Tbar on the quotient M agrees with the ambient dynamics on the image of the projection p (AgreesOnImage), then the selected representative map selectedS equals Tbar on M, so the descended dynamics is unique.
relations.hypotheses: SplitPresentation S : X to M, AmbientDynamics D, Tbar : M -> M, AgreesOnImage S.p D Tbar

relations.statement: The selected representative map agrees with the section: selectedS composed with the projection of a section point of m equals the dynamics projected on m.
relations.hypotheses: SplitPresentation Splt, AmbientDynamics D, m : M

relations.statement: A point off the section lies in the same fiber as the section point (fstBool offSection = fstBool (false,false)), so fiber membership alone does not fix the representative.

lemmas.statement: Fiber-preserving descended map is unique on M when it agrees with the ambient dynamics on the image of p (restates E012 theorem).

near_misses.claim: Same fiber under p implies the selected representative equals the ambient point, so descent agreement is automatic.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: same_fiber_off_section: offSection and (false,false) share fstBool but are distinct points, so the fiber does not determine the representative.
